note: Packs sold through Stripe Payment Links. The webhook grants the pack whose link was paid (the link is looked up with Stripe, never taken from the browser). `sessions`: general sessions for any drive (each used when a drive is completed). `allowances`: drives of one kind only (lesson, test = mock test, free = free drive); no pack gives them now (older Starter Passes did, and any left are used for any drive). `starter`: once per account (a second purchase is refunded automatically). Links are public addresses; which set is used follows the Stripe key (test or live), so live links take payments only on a server with a live key. `unlimited`: an unlimited pass, every kind of drive with nothing used: `days` from payment, or `monthly`; with `renews` it is a Stripe subscription, and each renewal (Stripe's invoice.paid) extends it to the end of the period paid for; it lapses when cancelled. `saleEnds`: the last day it is sold (UK). `retired`: no longer sold, kept so its payments and refunds are recognised. Prices shown come from Stripe (the Payment Link's price) once read; `price` until then. `deal` and `sticker`: shown on the pass (the owner's offer wording).
